title: 2-Hour Lake Tahoe Adventures ATV Tours in the Desert
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: The Ridge Run Tour takes you across a variety of terrains, including desert washes, rocky hills, and sagebrush flats that extend across the Carson Valley. As you ride, your guides will assist you in navigating the landscape. Along the way, you'll have opportunities to pause and enjoy breathtaking views, and capture memorable photos.
